name: 霧角鹿
subject: A MIST-ANTLER DEER, complete graceful four-legged stag with branching ivory antlers, tawny brown coat, soft pale grey spots and desaturated teal mist markings on flank.

name: 盤根樹衛
subject: A ROOTBOUND TREE GUARD, full thick timber humanoid with a stump-like stern face, branching mossy shoulders, two heavy root arms and two complete root legs; warm bark, dark moss and a few ochre leaves.

name: 苔背甲蟲
subject: A MOSS-BACK BEETLE, complete six-legged armored forest beetle, broad dark olive wing cases with patches of moss, bronze-brown head and mandibles, jointed hooked feet and short antennae.

name: 林間風靈
subject: A FOREST WIND SPIRIT, compact connected swirl-body with a small dark face, pale desaturated jade ribbons forming two arms, curling leafy lower tendrils, tiny ochre leaf accents; all ribbons connected to body.
